en: Color postcard showing a busy seaside resort with beaches, breakwaters, and a waterfront promenade lined with terraces and an outdoor restaurant. The reverse side is written in Romanian, bears a Romanian 40 bani stamp marked POSTA ROMANA, the printed title CARTE POSTALĂ, and publishing details. The sender mentions greetings from the sea and dates it 19.07.1973. The card is addressed to Bucharest. The front caption area notes EFORIE NORD.
